body:
Ready for a re-check.

New head `6189d8114` fixes the pre-review points on `2d0bf9ef2`:

1. Dirty draft: Duplicate in the tool editor is now disabled while the draft has unapplied edits. The disabled hover text is "the draft has unapplied changes: Apply or Cancel them first". The new test `tool_library_frame::a_dirty_draft_disables_duplicate_until_apply` pins it: the draft stays, no command lands, and Duplicate is enabled after Apply.
2. The MCP `duplicate_tool` description lists the "no free copy name" refusal. The row in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` follows, and `mcp_doc_drift` passes.
3. The PR body now has the merge-impact result, not a pointer to the hand-back.

Gate on `6189d8114` (log `gate-4482-6189d8114.log`): quick gate 394 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (site tests SKIP: zola and node are missing on the builder). Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` is clean. No merge of main and no hand-resolved hunk in this push. The PR stays a draft.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a `feat` PR, so it merges at the next cut. This is the first collaborator review of this PR.

Review tier: `effort:high` model. The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry. It adds a new tool entity and does not change an existing tool. Thus this is not a SAFETY-tier review. I ran two mutations all the same.

## What looks good

- `DuplicateTool` (`crates/app/src/commands/tool_duplicate.rs`) lands the same `ToolRecords` list that `DeleteTool` snapshots: definition, number, holder body, drawn cutter and component stack. A new tool record that is added to `ToolRecords` later goes into the copy automatically.
- All refusals occur in `new`, before the history: unknown name, not a tool, no free name, no free number. The name and the number are fixed when the command is made, so redo lands the same copy.
- The tool number comes from `tool_reservations::allocate` with the same `taken` list as `AddTool`.
- The free name checks the entity names and `reserved()` (setup furniture names). The stem rule only removes a numeric ` (n)` counter. A unit test pins the edge cases (`EM ()`, `(3)`, `EM (a)`).
- MCP `duplicate_tool` calls the same undoable command as the GUI. The generated reference and the site guide row are updated. `mcp_doc_drift` passes.
- UI: Duplicate is disabled while the main draft has unapplied edits, with a hover reason. A disabled click queues no command. The copy opens in the editor.
- Provenance lines on the new modules. All touched files are 400 lines or less (`state_tool_library_dialog.rs` is at 394).
- The body has before/after screenshots on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch (three PNGs, they resolve). It has a `Changelog:` line, `Process change: no` (correct: no process file changes), and `Fixes #4340`. The decision file `docs/decisions/4340-duplicate-tool.md` records what was chosen and dropped.
- No snapshot PNG, golden, `testdata/` or importer change. No new dependency and no new `camcraft-*` edge.

## Results (locally, on macOS, Apple M5 Max GPU)

Trial merge: the PR head already contains `upstream/main` `2394b5ad1` ("Already up to date"). The tested tree is the PR head `6189d8114`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ...`, 0 failed:
  - `app suites: lib`, `tool_library_holders`, `tool_library`, `mcp_doc_drift`, `mcp_delete_tool`, `example_catalog`: ok.
  - `app suites: mcp`, `mcp_edit_tool`, `mcp_holder`, `mcp_tool_body`, `mcp_tool_number`, `tool_numbers`, `tool_reservations`, `tool_reservations_extra`, `tool_body_assembly`, `tool_list`, `tool_table`, `tool_gate`: ok.
  - `ui suites: lib`: ok (79 s, GPU adapter present).
- The five `duplicate_tool::*` pinning tests: ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run by me: the other steps of the 394-step quick plan (the author reports all 394 green on this head). Heavy lanes: not reached by this diff, not run.

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff has no `testdata/` or fixture change and no importer change.

## Mutations (local, reverted)

1. `free_name` uses the source name as the stem, and `apply` does not land the records: 4 of 5 `duplicate_tool::*` tests go red. Reverted: green.
2. The footer enables Duplicate always (`add_enabled(true, ...)`): `tool_library_frame::a_dirty_draft_disables_duplicate_until_apply` goes red. Reverted: green.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `library_draft_changed` makes a `ToolUi` and two `Debug` strings on each frame while the editor is open. The cost is small. A cached result for each `doc_version` and draft change is possible later.
- The holder, body and stack drafts of the editor are not part of the dirty guard yet. The author filed this as #4506.
